verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an AI agent and automation platform, so durable long-running execution is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document workflows that wait for days or keep their state through worker or platform restarts. Human-in-the-loop approval pauses and one-time scheduled triggers are related but different features: they do not show durable state persistence or recovery after a restart.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state
